full_page.content:
1941, February 4
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of handwritten messages on Seraphic Mass Association Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M.Cap.
Mr. George V. Panyard -- for God's grace and guidance - Feb. 4 , 194 1 God bless you Mr. Panyard I hope this helps some way. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
1945, August 27
Poor Souls in Purgatory - for the intention of Geo. Panyard and associates and relatives for God's special guidance -
August 27 - 1945
God bless you George - you and yours.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Glad to hear from you George -
Was on retreat - all last week in Glen Cliff up the
Hudson 60 miles. Only To-night after 10 o'clock go
to your favor. Best regards to all - Mother, Doris, Grace and the rest - with God's loving blessing to all the little ones.
Fr. Solanus.
The originals in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Grove Rd. Apt. 17 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
